text:
Ana: Quick heads-up — I'm planning to enable the per_tenant_batching flag for a small set of canary tenants tomorrow 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC. Rollout plan: whitelist -> 5% tenancy for 30m -> 25% for 90m -> 100% if metrics stable.

Mike: What is the safe default if anything goes sideways? Can we force it off instantly?

Ana: Default remains OFF. We'll enable in whitelist mode for specific tenant IDs. If we need to stop: set mode to 'off' in config service. Config snippet:
```json
{
  "feature": "per_tenant_batching",
  "mode": "whitelist",
  "tenants": ["canary-1", "canary-2", "canary-3"],
  "batch_window_ms": 10
}
```

Cheng: What smoke tests should we run at go-time?

Ana: Smoke checklist:
- 100 requests to /v1/generate with header x-tenant: canary-1 (spread over 1m)
- p99 latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%
- no increase in 5xx or grpc retries from router
Commands:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 100); do 
  curl -s -H "x-tenant: canary-1" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' >/dev/null; 
  sleep 0.6;
done
```
Grafana panels: infra/latency, infra/errors, router/retries (I'll paste links in #dashboards).

deploy-bot: Scheduled the flag toggle for 2026-04-03T15:00:00Z. I will post status updates to this thread and #deploys.

Lisa: I'll run the smoke tests at go-time and report results here. If smoke fails, what's the immediate rollback action?

Ana: Rollback steps (immediate):
1) POST /config/flags/per_tenant_batching {"mode":"off"} (API toggle, should be immediate)
2) PATCH /router/config {"batching_enabled": false} to prevent new batching paths
3) If still bad, revert last config commit in config-repo and trigger router config rollout.
Also, let ops clear KV caches if needed.

oncall: I'll be on-call for the first 30m after flip. Alert thresholds to watch: p50 > 100ms, p95 > 300ms, errors > 0.5%. I'll escalate to infra if thresholds cross.

Mike: Any concerns about tenant-side compatibility (older SDKs, quantized models)?

Ana: We validated in staging across quantized and float runtime paths. Known edge-case: very long seq-length requests (>1024) may bypass batching and use conservative logic — we exclude those from canary.

Cheng: Can you share the exact canary tenant IDs so I can run the replay set and some targeted probes?

Ana: Canary list: canary-1, canary-2, canary-3. Replay ID: replay-20260402-1. I'll attach the replay results after preflight.

Lisa: :+1: I'll post smoke results and a quick table (p50/p95/errors) within 10m of the flip. I'll also keep terminal logs in the shared S3 path.

Mike: :thumbsup: LGTM from infra. Make sure the rollout window is marked in the team calendar and notify customer-facing channels if any tenants may see changes.

deploy-bot: Toggle queued — will post success/failure once the toggle runs.

Ana: Thanks all. Plan is to flip at 15:00 UTC. Ping here if you need to opt-out a tenant before then.
